title: Douglas County: 135 inmates were incarcerated in February
text:
The number of inmates incarcerated in Douglas County remained unchanged in February compared to the previous month, according to the Nevada Department of Corrections.
In total, there were 135 inmates in the county at the time.
Logan Alexander, a 22-year-old, was the youngest inmate incarcerated in Douglas County in February.
Harvey Glenn Hampton was the oldest at 69-years-old.
Every year, at least 38,000 people are booked into Nevada’s local jails.
Nevada has an incarceration rate of 610 per 100,000 people, which means it incarcerates a higher percentage of its population than any other democracy in the world — except for the United States.
